owner: Claude lane (schemas-strict) — the exact conventions tools/belt/checks/* enforce; injected by the controller into inputData.output_conventions so the generator is graded only on rules it was told. Sol folds these into prompts/*.md at the next re-pin.

02.dossier_sections.envelope_scope: kind MUST match what you emit: if sections contains all nine ids (A,B,C,C2,D,E,E2,F,G) then kind=complete_dossier, assigned_section_ids lists all nine, chunk_index=1, chunk_total=1. kind=partial_chunk is allowed ONLY when sections contains exactly the assigned_section_ids and nothing else. Prefer complete_dossier for a single-call section.
02.dossier_sections.sections.merge_seq: merge_seq values are 1..N contiguous and unique across the chunks of this envelope (N = number of chunks in the envelope); never reuse a global counter.
02.dossier_sections.sections.learner_facing: sections A and C are learner_facing:true (their prose may be shown to learners); B, C2, D, E, E2, F, G are learner_facing:false.
02.dossier_sections.sections.char_count: char_count = number of Unicode code points of sections[].markdown exactly as emitted; the validator recomputes it; it must be below section_char_limit (max 12000).
02.dossier_sections.citations: every fact-bearing line (any line containing a number, threshold, distance, time, age, fee, penalty, or a rule) must cite a declared source anchor: either inline as [Axx] on that line, or as the lead line of a fact block in the form 'FACT_ID: <id> | anchor: Axx' followed by the block's lines and a trailer 'Source: [Axx -> <source_page>]'. A line with no supporting page carries '(verify)' plus an open verification_debt claim_id instead of a value. Sections F (VERIFY list) and G (DoD matrix) are bookkeeping and are not graded for per-line citations.
02.dossier_sections.source_anchors: every anchor id used in markdown is declared in sections[].source_anchors with its registered source_page code; anchors never map to two pages.
02.dossier_sections.exam_facts: exam_facts entries are {value, status, source_page}; status unknown REQUIRES value null and source_page null; status verified REQUIRES a non-null value and a registered source_page; never fill a placeholder, never guess an exam name, body, count, time or threshold; verified facts supplied in safe_run_config.exam_facts may be restated with their source_page.
02.dossier_sections.numerals: no numeral whose fact status is not verified, and no value listed in verification_debt[].withheld_values, may appear in learner_facing sections.
02.dossier_sections.high_yield_ranked: one contiguous ranked list per knowledge domain present in the chunk; each entry names item_refs that exist in the chunk's fact ids.
02.dossier_sections.verification_debt: typed per the 02 contract: blocker_kind, source_tier_required, owner_worker, ship_blocking, expires_by, claim_id, located_at (chunk_id:Lnn).
02.dossier_sections.no_reproduction: no handbook sentence, table, image or official question is copied; original wording; no learner text overlaps the handbook by more than 12 consecutive normalized words.
02.dossier_sections.lineage: lineage.input_manifest_sha256 = the system header value bindings.input_manifest_sha256 (also runtime_bindings.input_manifest_sha256 when present); lineage.candidate_lineage_id = the system header value task.candidate_lineage_id; lineage.source_registry_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_registry_sha256; lineage.source_liveness_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_liveness_sha256. Copy exactly; never null, never invented.
02.dossier_sections.expected_merged_sha256: you cannot compute SHA-256 of your own output: set merge.expected_merged_sha256 to null (or 64 zeros); the validator computes and records the merged hash. For partial_chunk envelopes the merged hash is not compared.
02.dossier_sections.depth: DEPTH: this is a research dossier, not a summary. Section C must carry EVERY rule, threshold, distance, time, exception and definition found in the selected handbook pages, one FACT_ID block per fact (expect 1-3 blocks per handbook page; a 12-page section yields well over 10 blocks and 6,000–9,500 code points). A thin overview fails 02.DEPTH_FLOOR regardless of structure. Section A states exam/issuer facts only with verified status; B audience; C2 confusables; D accuracy flags; E/E2 market and teardown as typed debt if not researched; F VERIFY list; G DoD matrix.
02.dossier_sections.section_A_citations: every exam/issuer fact line in section A cites an anchor: declare one anchor per verified source_page given in safe_run_config.exam_facts (e.g. the handbook page for the passing standard) in source_anchors and put [Axx] on the line.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_located_at: G matrix located_at must be the exact chunk_id:Lnn of the line where that item actually appears (count lines of that chunk's markdown from 1); e.g. if "Misconceptions:" is line 54 of chunk C, write C:L54. The validator resolves every located_at; a wrong line number fails G_MATRIX. Put misconceptions, mnemonics, glossary and dynamic-fact isolation as clearly labelled lines in C and point at them.
02.dossier_sections.assigned_dossier_parts: When inputData.assigned_dossier_parts is present (e.g. ["C"]), emit kind=partial_chunk with assigned_section_ids EXACTLY equal to that list and a sections array containing ONLY those section ids — no other sections, no stubs for the others. chunk_index and chunk_total are as given in inputData.chunk_plan (default 1/1). Put the full depth into those parts: every rule, threshold, exception and definition in the selected pages, one FACT_ID block per fact. The G matrix, VERIFY list and other parts arrive in later calls and are merged deterministically by role 16; do not reference them here.
02.dossier_sections.needs_dedicated_surface: needs_dedicated_surface: list every scored sub-skill in the selected pages that needs its own practice mode (e.g. sign recognition, right-of-way scenarios) with status declared and a one-line why; if you cannot determine it from the pages, set status unknown AND add a verification_debt entry with blocker_kind exam_policy_unclear, located_at a line in section C, owner_worker 02, ship_blocking false. Never leave status unknown without that debt.
02.dossier_sections.sections_char_budget: HARD CAP: each sections[].markdown must stay BELOW 12,000 Unicode code points (the validator treats >= 12,000 as truncated and FAILs). Target 6,000–9,500 for section C: one FACT_ID block per fact, each block 2–4 lines (statement, why it matters, source) — terse, no repetition, no preamble paragraphs. If the selected pages hold more facts than fit, keep every fact but shorten the explanations; never drop facts to save space and never pad.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_on_partial: When the chunk does not include section G (e.g. assigned_dossier_parts ["C"]), emit g_matrix as an EMPTY array []. The DoD matrix is produced only with part G.
02.dossier_sections.merge_order_across_parts: Within your envelope, merge_seq is 1..N by document order. The dossier-wide order is NOT yours to encode: the validator/compiler merge parts in canonical section order A,B,C,C2,D,E,E2,F,G, then by merge_seq inside each section. Never continue another part's numbering.
02.dossier_sections.high_yield_on_C2: C2 is a knowledge continuation of C: when you emit C2 alone, its chunks carry a domain label and high_yield_ranked covers that domain (chunk_id must be one of your C2 chunks).
02.dossier_sections.depth_floor_numbers: HARD MINIMUMS per chunk (inputData.depth_floor, graded by 02.DEPTH_FLOOR): section A markdown >= 400 code points; section C >= 2500 code points AND >= 10 FACT_ID blocks; every other section >= 200 code points. Count before you emit; pad with substance (more rules, exceptions, definitions from the pages), never filler.
02.dossier_sections.exam_facts_by_part: Only part A authors exam_facts (exam_name, issuing_body, edition, … with status verified when restating safe_run_config.exam_facts, else unknown). Every other part emits each exam_facts entry as {value:null, status:unknown, source_page:null} — not asserted — so the merge never sees two different authored values.
02.dossier_sections.dedicated_surface_by_part: needs_dedicated_surface is authored with part C (declared/none_required with items, or unknown backed by an exam_policy_unclear VerificationDebt located in C). Every other part emits {status: unknown, items: []} — not asserted here.
02.dossier_sections.g_matrix_located_at_format: g_matrix[].located_at is a chunk_id EXACTLY as it appears in sections[].chunk_id (e.g. "G.01", or a sibling part's chunk such as "C.01" when the box is evidenced there). An optional ":L<n>" line suffix is tolerated; nothing else (no headings, no page refs).
02.dossier_sections.lineage_hashes: lineage.source_registry_sha256 = runtime_bindings.source_registry_sha256 and lineage.input_manifest_sha256 = runtime_bindings.input_manifest_sha256 (copy both exactly, in EVERY part, even parts that cite nothing). Never leave them empty.

03.combined_kg.node_identity: One node per FACT_ID of the compiled dossier: node.id EQUALS the fact id (e.g. "ROR-SIG-01"), node.fact_ids = [that id]. Every fact id you use (nodes, confusables, dynamic_nodes) must exist in accepted_inputs / the fact registry — never invent ids.
03.combined_kg.high_yield_set: nodes[].high_yield is true for EXACTLY the ids listed in accepted_inputs.high_yield_ids (copy that list; no extras, none missing). Every high_yield node needs confusable_with[] with >=1 entry OR a non-empty no_confusable_reason.
03.combined_kg.confusables: confusable_with[] entries are {other_id, why, fact_ids}: other_id is another node id (never itself), why is non-empty, fact_ids includes at least one fact of THIS node and at least one fact of other_id (with node=fact identity that is [this.id, other_id]).
03.combined_kg.modules: modules[] = {module_id, node_ids[], official_weight, pedagogic_emphasis}. Every stable node appears in EXACTLY ONE module and node.module_id names it. Dynamic nodes (dynamic_nodes[]) never appear in nodes[], modules[] or learning_path.
03.combined_kg.learning_path: learning_path lists EVERY stable node id exactly once, in an order with zero prerequisite violations (if edge A->B type prerequisite then A before B). learning_path_rule = {dynamic_excluded: true, rule: "<short rule text>"}.
03.combined_kg.edges: edges[] = {from, to, type, confidence}: endpoints resolve to node ids, no self loops, confidence is a number in [0,1] (never null). type/edge types and node types must be declared in the ontology block (kg02). The prerequisite subgraph must be acyclic. kg03.edges must be the SAME list as edges[] (identical records).
03.combined_kg.weights_honesty: official_weight = {value, status, source_page}. The Utah handbook publishes NO domain weights: use status "unknown" with value null and source_page null everywhere, OR status "authored" with a number and source_page null when you deliberately author emphasis. NEVER status unknown with a number, never status verified (there is no official blueprint page).
03.combined_kg.pedagogic_emphasis: Every node and module carries pedagogic_emphasis = {value: positive number, basis: non-empty text}. department_pass.kg04.domain_emphasis_check has ONE row per distinct node.domain: {domain, weight_status, computed_pct, blueprint_pct, drift_pp, within_tolerance, comparison_basis}. computed_pct = 100 * (sum of node emphasis in that domain) / (sum over all nodes), to 0.1. With weight_status unknown: blueprint_pct, drift_pp, within_tolerance are null and comparison_basis is NOT "official_verified" (use "authored_emphasis").
03.combined_kg.weight_closure: department_pass.kg02.weight_closure = {basis, sum, within_tolerance}. If module official_weight statuses are all unknown: basis "unknown", sum null, within_tolerance null. If all authored: basis "authored", module weights sum to 100 (±1), sum = that number, within_tolerance true.
03.combined_kg.kg05_assertions: department_pass.kg05.validation_assertions {prerequisite_violations, orphan_nodes, double_homes, dynamic_quarantined, path_check}: set every field to null (unclaimed) — the validator recomputes them; a wrong claimed number FAILS.
03.combined_kg.curriculum_hints: curriculum_unit_hints[]: EXACTLY one per module: {unit_id (unique), module_id, node_ids (same set as the module), user_cycle starting ["session","flashcards","module_hub", ...] with module_quiz only AFTER module_hub, hub_options including "module_quiz","flashcards","session", session_strategy, flashcard_strategy, quiz_strategy all non-empty}.
03.combined_kg.source_refs: source_refs.image_scout_pre_kg MUST be the literal "deferred:not_applicable_pilot". source_refs.learning_loop MUST equal accepted_inputs.learning_loop_ref exactly (copy the string).
03.combined_kg.probe_and_lineage: probe is the run slug (lowercase, digits, hyphens). lineage.input_manifest_sha256 and lineage.candidate_lineage_id are copied from runtime_bindings / safe_run_config exactly.
03.combined_kg.scope: Graph ONLY the accepted Section 9 dossier facts (Rules of the Road). Domains = the dossier domain labels. Keep it complete, not padded: every fact becomes a node; no nodes without a registered fact.
